name: UI Core & Navigation
summary: Implementation largely matches design with some notable gaps. F-key navigation, command bar layout, and info panel states are well-implemented. Key issues: missing GAME/menu screen implementation (F10/ESC confusion), inconsistent MAP handling (F1 vs separate MAP button behavior), and some production slider UI not matching MOO1 wireframes in InfoPanel. The codebase shows clear design adherence for core navigation patterns.

matches.description: Command bar implements the 8-button layout per design: GAME, DESIGN, FLEET, MAP, RACES, PLANETS, TECH, NEXT TURN. F-key labels are displayed below each button. Status bar embedded with Turn, Year, BC, RP matches design.
F1-F6 screen navigation implemented correctly. F1=galaxy, F2=planet_list, F3=fleet, F4=research, F5=diplomacy, F6=ship_design matches design specification.
Modal screens (combat, ground_combat, turn_summary) block F-key navigation as specified in design: 'True modals (Combat, Council Vote, Game Menu, start-of-turn popups) block F-key navigation.'
Enter/Space triggers Next Turn on galaxy map, matching design spec §2.1: 'Enter / Space = End Turn'.
Arrow key panning on galaxy map implemented with PAN_STEP=20 and Shift+Arrow fast pan at PAN_STEP_FAST=60. Matches design: 'Shift+Arrows = Fast Pan'.
Zoom controls (+/=/- keys) implemented correctly. Zoom step of 0.25 per keypress. '0' resets zoom as specified.
Ctrl+S Quick Save and Ctrl+L Load Game shortcuts implemented per design §2.1.
Info panel states match design: renderUnexplored, renderUncolonized, renderYourColony, renderEnemyColony, renderFleetDeployment, renderFleetInTransit. Context-sensitive panel behavior as specified.
Fleet deployment panel matches MOO1 wireframe: ship rows with << < [count] > >> controls, ETA display, CANCEL/ACCEPT buttons, destination selection flow.
COUNCIL button correctly disabled when council not active, with feedback toast 'Council not yet formed'. Matches design: 'F8 = Council (only when Council is in session)'.
Background color '#000010' approximates the design's 'Deep Space Blue: #0a1628'. Star rendering with glow effects present.
Turn summary handled as overlay that hides underlying screen, matching design modal behavior. ESC dismisses turn summary as specified.
ESC from main screens returns to Galaxy Map (F1) as specified: 'ESC from any main screen returns to Galaxy Map.'

mismatches.design_spec: F10 intentionally omitted — ESC is the sole Game Menu trigger.
mismatches.actual_impl: CommandBar defines GAME button with fkey 'F10' but App.ts F_KEY_MAP has no F10 entry. The GAME button navigates to screen 'menu', but there's no 'menu' in F_KEY_MAP.
mismatches.recommendation: Remove F10 from CommandBar's GAME button fkey display (change to 'ESC' or remove fkey label entirely). Ensure ESC is clearly indicated as the Game Menu trigger.

mismatches.design_spec: The MAP button opens a **separate full-screen MAP view** — a completely different rendering mode from the normal Galaxy View. Within the MAP screen, three mode buttons on the right panel filter what data is displayed.
mismatches.actual_impl: MAP button (fkey F1) navigates to 'galaxy' screen. There's no separate 'map' screen type implementing the full-screen MAP view with Colonies/Environment/Minerals modes described in design.
mismatches.recommendation: Either implement a separate 'map' ScreenType with the three overlay modes, or add the MAP mode toggle functionality to the existing galaxy screen. The design describes MAP as a distinct full-screen view from the normal Galaxy Map.

mismatches.actual_impl: CommandBar has REPORTS button with F7, but it's listed AFTER TECH (F4). Design shows consistent F1-F8 ordering. Also, F_KEY_MAP in App.ts correctly has F7: 'reports', but CommandBar's button order doesn't match the F-key number order.
mismatches.recommendation: Reorder NAV_BUTTONS array in CommandBar.ts to match F-key numerical order: GAME(F10), DESIGN(F6), FLEET(F3), MAP(F1), RACES(F5), PLANETS(F2), TECH(F4), REPORTS(F7), COUNCIL(F8). The current order mixes F-key numbers.

mismatches.actual_impl: InfoPanel.renderYourColony() does not render the 5 production sliders (SHIP/DEF/IND/ECO/TECH). It shows colony stats and current build but omits the slider UI that design specifies for the right info panel.
mismatches.recommendation: Add production slider rendering to InfoPanel.renderYourColony(). The design shows 5 sliders totaling 100% with progress bars and current allocation percentages in the info panel when a colony is selected.

mismatches.design_spec: Color Palette - Deep Space Blue: #0a1628 (backgrounds), Panel Background: #1a2a3a (info panels), Highlight: #4a90d9 (selection)
mismatches.actual_impl: Canvas background uses '#000010' instead of design's '#0a1628'. This is a slight color variance.
mismatches.recommendation: Update clearCanvas() to use the design-specified color '#0a1628' for consistency with the UI color palette.

mismatches.design_spec: Screen transitions should use FADE transition with 200ms duration and ease-in-out easing for standard screen navigation (F1-F7).
mismatches.actual_impl: Screen transitions are implemented with show()/hide() methods but no fade animation timing is visible in the App class. Animation may be CSS-based but no 200ms duration is explicitly enforced in JS.
mismatches.recommendation: Verify CSS transitions match design spec (200ms ease-in-out fade). If animations are not implemented, add CSS transitions to .screen class or implement in show()/hide() methods.

mismatches.design_spec: Galaxy Map Shortcuts: N = Next Colony, Shift+N = Prev Colony, F = Next Fleet, Shift+F = Prev Fleet, G = Toggle Grid, R = Range Circles, T = Trade Routes, E = Highlight Enemy Fleets
mismatches.actual_impl: Galaxy-map-only key handling only implements arrow panning and zoom. Missing: N/Shift+N colony cycling, F/Shift+F fleet cycling, G grid toggle, R range circles, T trade routes, E enemy highlight.
mismatches.recommendation: Implement the galaxy-map-specific letter shortcuts from interaction-spec.md §2.2. These should dispatch appropriate actions for colony/fleet cycling and overlay toggles.

mismatches.design_spec: F8 = High Council (only when Council is in session; otherwise no-op)
mismatches.actual_impl: F8 council check uses state.highCouncil?.isActive but CommandBar additionally checks isCouncilFormationMet(state). The behavior differs slightly: App allows navigation only when isActive, CommandBar allows when forming OR active.
mismatches.recommendation: Align F8 behavior between App.ts and CommandBar.ts. Both should use the same condition (either isActive only, or isActive OR forming).

missing_from_code.feature: Separate MAP screen with Colonies/Environment/Minerals filter modes. Design describes 'The MAP button opens a **separate full-screen MAP view**' with three mode buttons, but code routes MAP to 'galaxy' screen.
5 Production sliders (SHIP/DEF/IND/ECO/TECH) in the info panel when a colony is selected. The design wireframe shows these prominently but InfoPanel.renderYourColony() doesn't render them.
Galaxy map letter shortcuts: N (Next Colony), Shift+N (Prev Colony), F (Next Fleet), Shift+F (Prev Fleet), G (Toggle Grid), R (Range Circles), T (Trade Routes), E (Enemy Fleets).

Turn end confirmation dialog. Design shows: 'Shows automatically when player presses Enter/End Turn. Summarizes all actions that will execute. Highlights warnings for undefended colonies, idle production.' Code dispatches NEXT_TURN directly without confirmation.
Right-click context menus on Galaxy Map (star, fleet, empty space contexts). Design specifies detailed context menu layouts but no right-click handling visible in reviewed files.
Middle-click map panning. Design: 'Hold middle + drag = pan view'. Code only implements keyboard arrow panning and doesn't show middle-click handling.

not_in_design.feature: Speed control buttons (SPEED: ▶ ▶▶ ▶▶▶) with slow/normal/fast animation speeds. Not mentioned in any of the design documents reviewed. May be a QoL addition but not in spec.

Victory screen handling with victoryActive flag and isGameOver/victoryResult state checks. The victory screen flow exists but specific screen transition behavior wasn't detailed in the UI core design docs (may be in other docs).
Toast notification system (showToast method) for user feedback. Not specified in reviewed design docs but reasonable UX addition.
File-based save/load with browser download/upload. Design mentions Save/Load in game menu but file export/import specifics not in reviewed docs.
